name: hover-video-player

frames.best_why: Frame 6 shows the full swirling clip with no cursor over it; frame 2 is blank.

tagline: A still that comes alive with swirling video when pointed at.
summary: A rounded video tile that holds on a thumbnail until the pointer arrives, then plays a muted looping clip inside the frame and fades back to the still when the pointer leaves.
appearance: A wide rounded rectangle near the top of a dark stage holds an abstract close-up of red and blue paint curling together. Below it a small grey caption reads "Hover to play the video".
behaviour: Idle, the frame holds a still image. Hovering swaps it for moving footage and the paint churns; leaving the pointer pauses the clip and fades the still back. Optional controls slide up from the bottom while hovering.
demo_content: Caption "Hover to play the video" over a red and blue swirling paint clip.
search_phrases: video that plays when you hover
video card preview on mouse over
in page video with hover playback
showreel teaser that starts on hover
hover preview for a video link
silent looping clip inside a card
use_when: You want a quiet preview clip to play inside the page when a visitor points at it.
avoid_when: Touch users get no automatic preview, because a tap only toggles the controls and playback.
customise: videoSrc and thumbnailSrc supply the media; muted, loop, preload, overlays and control flags are props. Colours and control styling need a source edit.
weight_why: Decodes and draws a looping video while hovered, plus a few motion overlays.

a11y.note: Hover starts playback and the still is the only cue; keyboard users reach the controls but cannot trigger the preview.

issues: Frame 2 shows an empty black area, so no thumbnail appeared before hover.
The idle frame gives no play affordance except the demo's caption below it.
The source logs to the console on every hover and playback step.
polish_why: Clean rounded video frame, but the resting state is a bare still with no obvious cue.
